v2.6.4 — STUCK FREEZE RELEASE:

🎯 Fixes apps frozen with an older freezer version that refuse to unfreeze.

Root cause: Android has TWO separate blocking states — disabled and suspended (Samsung Knox Guard uses the suspended state too). An app stuck in the suspended state can NEVER be released by the normal unfreeze command, so older attempts bounced right off it.

✅ Unfreeze now fires a full release artillery: pm enable (both forms) + pm unsuspend (both forms), stopping the moment the device confirms the app is truly free.

✅ The frozen list now reads BOTH states, so stuck apps finally show as FROZEN — and tapping them (or Unfreeze All) will break the old freeze loose.

Same cert, updates in place over v2.6.3.
